test_title: PYST 29 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 22 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain coded language 'PANELS' is coded as 'YQITFT' and 'HACKED' is coded as 'JJOIFL'. How will 'QUIRES' be coded in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96a2fa916718f3b4fb5c523c309f929ae8a38db6af17c91bbd18d68bf8490a35.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Here,

PANELS → YQITFT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57f42b1cb0a2f85b804e6b05508567434a9e0fe7f75935cbc3141912ed7a3973.png] 

HACKED → JJOIFL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/458a8e6e7e2d9b7062ba73758d1a32d6b9c358c4ff14e835b7e17ecba49e2df4.png] 

Now apply the same pattern to **QUIRES**:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e58df05de4eabf82c07e5241c3e4e1ca8aae6e9a51c99439c473c9eb17d479c5.png] 

So, the code becomes YJVOZU

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
